title: CamSol
description: Connect your Cambridge account privately. Login and read-only form inspection; calculation submission is not yet qualified.

CAMSOL_EMAIL.title: Cambridge username or email
CAMSOL_EMAIL.description: Your existing Cambridge CamSol username or email. Stored encrypted for your LibreChat user; never sent to the chat model.

CAMSOL_PASSWORD.title: Cambridge account password
CAMSOL_PASSWORD.description: Your existing CamSol password. Used only for the normal Cambridge login over HTTPS; do not paste it into chat.

serverInstructions: Use connect_camsol only when the user asks to connect their Cambridge account. Read status and inspect actual forms via GET. This external-provider connector cannot submit calculations. Never ask for credentials in chat, bypass a challenge, infer a calculation API, or send scientific inputs. An authenticated form does not establish calculation readiness.
